summary: Verified web payment fix: backend returns 409 with meaningful detail when gateway keys are missing; X-Pay-Return-Base header is validated (anti open-redirect); hosted PayU callback uses the trusted rb for the SPA redirect; /payment/return page loads at root. Frontend code review confirms runPayment catches errors, surfaces toast via lastPayError, and Checkout.jsx renders the reason in data-testid='order-failed-reason'.

issues: Multiple stacked modals (Allow location, Service completed rating prompt, Turn on alerts) appear simultaneously on load and block interaction for automation/users; recommend sequencing or auto-dismissing after a timeout.

critical_code_review_comments: payment_gateways.safe_return_base correctly blocks open-redirect: untrusted hosts return empty, callers fall back to PUBLIC_APP_URL. Confirmed behavior for evil.com -> empty.
hosted_callback (payu/easebuzz) honors rb only when trusted; falls back to _public_base()+optional RETURN_PREFIX. Working as intended.
web_panel runPayment wrapper catches all errors (axios + inline) into lastPayError and shows toast; Checkout.jsx shows reason text via data-testid='order-failed-reason' (verified source).
api.js injects X-Pay-Return-Base = window.location.origin + PUBLIC_URL on every request; server middleware stores it in a ContextVar for later use by return_page().

success_rate.frontend: code-review verified; live click-through blocked by stacked modals

verification_results.payments_order_no_keys: 409 with detail='Razorpay TEST MODE (pay-in) is not fully configured.' (expected)
verification_results.payu_surl_untrusted_rb: surl has NO rb parameter (expected, evil.com stripped)
verification_results.payu_callback_untrusted_rb: 303 Location: <preview>/payment/return?gw=payu&order_id=T1 (safe fallback to PUBLIC_APP_URL — evil.com NOT present; note: without ret param, path uses root /payment/return rather than /api/panel/payment/return, which still resolves correctly because the web SPA serves /payment/return at root)
verification_results.payment_return_root: HTTP 200 with 'Payment not completed' text at <preview>/payment/return?gw=payu&order_id=UNKNOWN (expected)
